$note: Curated known gaps and cautions. Carried verbatim into dataset.data_quality.
data_quality: All statements are cash basis. Real estate tax, insurance and snow are lumpy by payment date, so year-over-year category moves in a single period can be timing. Prefer FY and TTM views for tax and insurance.
The consolidated 2026 YTD P&Ls in the folder end around 2026-06-12 (three are labeled 12/31/26). The monthly PM exports run through 2026-09-30 and are the basis for all 2026 numbers here.

Monthly data reconciles to the annual P&Ls to the dollar for Rarig, Broadway, Info Lane, 3540 E 5th, Red Branch and FVC (FY2024, FY2025). Livingston FY2025 differs by $190,715 of opex (July 2025 export missing). 9620 FY2025 revenue now ties to the annual file ($5,544); the $49,900 gap (monthly $516) came from the single-month 2025-09 recap, whose expense lines were read as revenue, and was corrected on 2026-10-05. 9620 FY2025 opex ties except management fees, $13,530 above the annual file (monthly $9,500 against $178,332).
FVC is an all-properties aggregate (Sepich portfolio). Property-level and unit-level results are not available from the files.
Missing monthly exports: Westerville 2024-01 to 2024-08 and 2024-10; Livingston 2024-01 to 2025-05 and 2025-07; 9620 2024-01 to 2024-08 (pre-ownership).
55 New Plant (EGFLLC) and 1851 South Club Solar are entity-level annual QuickBooks statements with no monthly detail. Their 2026 figures end about 2026-06-12.

NOI here is normalized: revenue less recurring operating cost. Capital items, leasing commissions, tenant improvements, owner distributions, debt service, interest, depreciation and entity income tax are excluded. Security deposit receipts and prepaid rent are excluded from revenue, with one treatment for every statement layout: AppFolio unallocated prepays and the Yardi cash-flow Prepaid Rental Income line (Broadway, Red Branch) are both excluded (ruling 2026-10-06; until then the Yardi line was counted as contra-revenue). PM-reported NOI differs: for example FVC reported NOI nets $123,879 of owner distributions and $97,728 of replacements in FY2025.
2203-2207 Northwood is excluded as instructed. Its P&Ls are in the folder but were not used.
Square footage, lease expiration dates and tenant rolls are not in the P&L files. $/SF metrics need the Master Workbook or Notion tenant data. Only the six leases above provide SF.
The Sepich all-properties HTML export (2015 to 2026-09-30) was not used. It is one cumulative period.
Owner distribution and contribution signs differ between PM report layouts. Treat the dist field as net owner cash out as reported, not as a control total.
